tools.name: browser-view
tools.description: Show a visible browser tab to the user: ensures the tab (yours) and the live stream the Browser window attaches to. Used by the Teros UI; answers { streamId, tabId, state }.

tabId.description: The Browser window id (stable per window)

url.description: URL to load when the tab is new (optional)

tools.name: browser-open-tab
tools.description: Open a VISIBLE browser tab for the user (it appears as a Browser window in Teros) and point the other browser tools at it. The user must enable "Agent control" in that window before you can act in it; reading (snapshot, screenshot) always works.

tabId.description: Optional stable id; generated when absent

tools.name: browser-list-tabs
tools.description: List the visible browser tabs of the current user, with who is watching and whether agent control is on.

tools.name: browser-close-tab
tools.description: Close a visible browser tab (the Browser window shows it as closed).

tools.name: browser-use-tab
tools.description: Point every other browser tool at a VISIBLE tab the user can see (from browser-list-tabs / browser-open-tab), or pass tabId null to go back to your own headless page. Answers the tab's state and who controls it.

tabId.description: A visible tab id, or null for the headless page

tools.name: browser-control
tools.description: Who controls the current visible tab: status, or take/release advisory agent priority. The person at the tab always wins; consent is the user's toggle.

tools.name: browser-suggest
tools.description: Address-bar suggestions for the Browser window: the user's visit history here + search completions. Used by the Teros UI.

tools.name: -health-check
tools.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies browser availability.

tools.name: browser-close
tools.description: Close the page

tools.name: browser-resize
tools.description: Resize the browser window

tools.name: browser-console-messages
tools.description: Returns console messages with filtering options

level.description: Level of the console messages to return. Each level includes the messages of more severe levels. Defaults to "info".

sinceTimestamp.description: Only messages after this timestamp (ms). Use lastTimestamp from previous response to iterate.

since.description: Preset filters: all, since last navigation, since last action (click/type/etc)

tools.name: browser-console-errors
tools.description: Returns only error messages (shortcut for level=error)

tools.name: browser-console-clear
tools.description: Clear all captured console messages

tools.name: browser-handle-dialog
tools.description: Handle a dialog

promptText.description: The text of the prompt in case of a prompt dialog.

tools.name: browser-evaluate
tools.description: Evaluate JavaScript expression on page or element

function.description: () => { /* code */ } or (element) => { /* code */ } when element is provided

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

ref.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot

tools.name: browser-file-upload
tools.description: Upload one or multiple files

paths.description: The absolute paths to the files to upload. Can be single file or multiple files. If omitted, file chooser is cancelled.

tools.name: browser-fill-form
tools.description: Fill multiple form fields

ref.description: Exact target field reference from the page snapshot

value.description: Value to fill in the field. If the field is a checkbox, the value should be `true` or `false`. If the field is a combobox, the value should be the text of the option.

tools.name: browser-install
tools.description: Install the browser specified in the config. Call this if you get an error about the browser not being installed.

tools.name: browser-press-key
tools.description: Press a key on the keyboard

key.description: Name of the key to press or a character to generate, such as `ArrowLeft` or `a`

tools.name: browser-type
tools.description: Type text into editable element

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

ref.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot

text.description: Text to type into the element

submit.description: Whether to submit entered text (press Enter after)

slowly.description: Whether to type one character at a time. Useful for triggering key handlers in the page. By default entire text is filled in at once.

tools.name: browser-navigate
tools.description: Navigate to a URL

waitUntil.description: When to consider navigation complete: "load" (full page load), "domcontentloaded" (DOM ready, default), "networkidle" (no network activity for 500ms). Use "networkidle" for pages that load content dynamically.

tools.name: browser-navigate-back
tools.description: Go back to the previous page

tools.name: browser-network-requests
tools.description: Returns all network requests since loading the page

includeStatic.description: Whether to include successful static resources like images, fonts, scripts, etc. Defaults to false.

tools.name: browser-run-code
tools.description: Run browser automation code snippet

code.description: A JavaScript function containing browser automation code to execute. It will be invoked with a single argument containing { page, context, browser }. For example: `async ({ page, context, browser }) => { await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Submit' }).click(); return await page.title(); }`

tools.name: browser-take-screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the current page. You can't perform actions based on the screenshot, use browser_snapshot for actions. The screenshot is saved to /workspace/ (shared volume) and persisted to the object store (permanent URL in the result).

type.description: Image format for the screenshot. Default is png.

filename.description: File name for the screenshot (e.g., "screenshot.png"). Saved to /workspace/. Defaults to screenshot-{timestamp}.{png|jpeg}.

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to screenshot the element. If not provided, the screenshot will be taken of viewport. If element is provided, ref must be provided too.

ref.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot. If not provided, the screenshot will be taken of viewport. If ref is provided, element must be provided too.

fullPage.description: When true, takes a screenshot of the full scrollable page, instead of the currently visible viewport. Cannot be used with element screenshots.

tools.name: browser-snapshot
tools.description: Capture accessibility snapshot of the current page, this is better than screenshot

filename.description: Save snapshot to markdown file in /workspace/ instead of returning it in the response (e.g., "snapshot.md").

tools.name: browser-click
tools.description: Perform click on a web page

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

ref.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot

doubleClick.description: Whether to perform a double click instead of a single click

button.description: Button to click, defaults to left

tools.name: browser-drag
tools.description: Perform drag and drop between two elements

startElement.description: Human-readable source element description used to obtain the permission to interact with the element

startRef.description: Exact source element reference from the page snapshot

endElement.description: Human-readable target element description used to obtain the permission to interact with the element

endRef.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot

tools.name: browser-hover
tools.description: Hover over element on page

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

ref.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot

tools.name: browser-select-option
tools.description: Select an option in a dropdown

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

ref.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot

values.description: Array of values to select in the dropdown. This can be a single value or multiple values.

tools.name: browser-tabs
tools.description: List, create, close, or select a browser tab.

index.description: Tab index, used for close/select. If omitted for close, current tab is closed.

tools.name: browser-wait-for
tools.description: Wait for text to appear or disappear, a URL to load, network idle, or a specified time to pass

time.description: The time to wait in seconds

textGone.description: The text to wait for to disappear

url.description: Wait for the page URL to contain or match this string (partial match). Useful for OAuth redirects.

networkIdle.description: Wait until there are no network connections for at least 500ms. Useful for SPA content loading.

tools.name: browser-start-recording
tools.description: Start recording a video of the browser. Creates a new browser context with video recording enabled. Use browser-stop-recording to finalize and save the video file. All navigation and interaction tools will be captured in the recording.

outputDir.description: Directory to save the video file (default: /workspace/videos)

tools.name: browser-stop-recording
tools.description: Stop recording and save the video file. Closes the current browser context (which finalizes the video) and returns the path to the saved .webm file. The video is saved to /workspace/videos/ (or /workspace/<path> when the filename includes one) and persisted to the object store (permanent URL in the result). A new non-recording context is created automatically so the browser remains usable.

filename.description: Optional custom filename for the video (e.g., "gmail-tutorial.webm"). Saved to /workspace/videos/ (or /workspace/<path> when it includes one). Defaults to the Playwright temp name.

tools.name: browser-emulate-device
tools.description: Emulate a specific device or custom viewport. Recreates the browser context with the specified device settings. Useful for recording tutorials on mobile vs desktop views.

device.description: Preset device to emulate. Selecting a preset sets viewport, user agent, and touch settings automatically.

width.description: Custom viewport width (used when device is not specified)

height.description: Custom viewport height (used when device is not specified)

userAgent.description: Custom user agent string (used when device is not specified)

isMobile.description: Whether to emulate a mobile device (used when device is not specified)

hasTouch.description: Whether to enable touch events (used when device is not specified)

tools.name: browser-html-to-pdf
tools.description: Generate a high-fidelity PDF from a local HTML file or URL. Renders with real Chromium: full CSS, web fonts and backgrounds preserved, with painted margins on every page (dark-background safe).

inputPath.description: Path to a local HTML file (mutually exclusive with url)

url.description: http(s) URL to render (mutually exclusive with inputPath)

outputPath.description: Destination path for the PDF file

margin.description: Inner margin painted with the page background, e.g. "12mm" (default 12mm)

waitForFonts.description: Wait for web fonts before printing (default true)

printCss.description: Optional extra CSS injected for per-document pagination rules
